items.title: Stopping business email compromise with AI-driven email security: How VIPRE protects modern enterprises on AWS
items.summary: Learn how VIPRE Security built an AI-powered email security solution on AWS to stop business email compromise. VIPRE Integrated Email Security uses machine learning and a serverless architecture on Amazon ECS, Amazon SQS, and Amazon S3 to detect and block sophisticated email impersonation in real time, without MX record changes.
items.creator: Pedram Jahangiri

items.title: Bulk Executor for Amazon DynamoDB, Part 2: Lessons we learned the hard way
items.summary: In Part 2 of our Bulk Executor for Amazon DynamoDB series, we share how we built the tool: the design tradeoffs, surprises, and workarounds we hit while working with DynamoDB and AWS Glue. Consider it a travel guide for anyone building their own bulk tooling on AWS Glue.
items.creator: Jason Hunter
